A '''training center''' for the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] was located in the [[Scrumma Jawbone]], an arm of [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The center was established by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]] to allow [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]], [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Infantry/Legends|infantry]], to practice with projectile [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] such as [[Atlatl/Legends|atlatls]], [[Cesta/Legends|cestas]], and [[arbalest]]s. The center's ingenious shooting range utilized hovering [[Methane/Legends|methane]]-filled gasbags and floating bull's [[Eye/Legends|eye]] targets, which could move above and below [[Water/Legends|water]] on command. The [[Species/Legends|species]] in the surrounding [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] knew to stay away from the training center when classes were underway.<ref name="Weapons" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Scrumma Jawbone training center was mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'', a [[2004]] reference book by [[W. Haden Blackman]].<ref name="Weapons" />
